verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a hardware system-on-chip, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user automations is a software workflow capability outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip itself ships any automation-management feature; the evidence covers only compute, GPU, media-engine, ML-acceleration, and connectivity specifications.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
